sources.caveat: Unmatched livestream aggregate samples: formats, straddles, opponents, dates and effective stacks differ. Directional checks only; not an objective function or proof of identical real-player strategy. Per-turn/river bluff rates were not available. Britney's requested short-stack preset is not her aggregate career sample.

definitions.pfr: At least one preflop raise / hands dealt
definitions.air: Engine coarse hand class 0, not verified bluff intent
definitions.initiative_bet: Bets / legal free-bet decisions by previous-street aggressor; not guaranteed identical to source c-bet definition
definitions.wilson95: Binomial descriptive interval; decisions within a hand and continuous-session hands are correlated, so not a clustered confidence interval

acceptance.description: Completeness, stage coverage, persona ordering and independent-seed preflop stability; no assertion of exact real-player fidelity.

methodology.runs: Baseline + two calibration rounds using seed 26112601; independent frozen-policy holdout seed 26112699; continuous sessions seed 26112677, maximum 200 hands per session, reset at normal session end.
methodology.population: Fresh runs: 80% eight-seat /20% six-seat tables, seven/five randomly selected unique stars and a 100 BB GTO hero. Persona-specific fresh buy-ins each hand. Continuous run carries stacks, bustouts and button forward, with no artificial rebuy; table_size there labels initial rather than current seat count.
methodology.sampling: Unmodified production Bot.decide, 220/320 postflop equity iterations and 500 preflop all-in iterations. Four JVM workers, 2 GB test heap. Counts are completed game hands, not equity iterations.
methodology.checks: Every decision: nonnegative normalized policy, legal options, bounded equity; every completed hand: chip conservation and zero-sum net; maximum 250 transitions. Seeds stable across fresh-mode worker partitions. Continuous mode depends on worker count.
methodology.limits: Not a solver or replica of real private strategies. Observational rates depend on composition, prices, ranges and survivorship; no per-street real bluff labels. Fresh hands do not model session adaptation; continuous run tests stack transitions but bots do not learn opponents. JVM runtime is not an iPhone performance benchmark. First three rounds reuse starting seeds and are not independent replications.
methodology.metrics: All rates retain events/opportunities; air uses coarse engine class 0, draw class 1. Only free-bet opportunities with raising legal count for air bets. Fold/call denominators are decisions facing a bet; raise denominator is legal-raise decisions. Sizing counts exclude raises facing bets, but include jam sizes/clamping. Wilson intervals are descriptive and do not correct within-hand/session correlation.
methodology.reproduce: RR_LARGE_DIR=/absolute/run RR_LARGE_HANDS=1000000 RR_LARGE_SEED=26112699 RR_LARGE_WORKERS=4 ./gradlew :engine:jvmTest --tests "*LargeStarAuditTest.millionHandAudit*"; then python3 tools/summarize_star_audit.py /absolute/run. For continuous mode add RR_LARGE_SESSION_HANDS=200.

changes.peter: Slightly wider opening; sticky calls retained, more flop continuation and less automatic value raising.
changes.dwan: Wider defense with selective early aggression and polarized late value/bluff sizes.
changes.britney: 20–35 BB preset retained; slightly more cheap flat calls, short shoves remain; deep-stack behavior uses ordinary postflop decisions.
changes.texas_mike: Wider opening, stronger isolation/3-bets and more semi-bluff pressure.
changes.wang_ye: Modestly wider opening, more isolation/3-bets and controlled draw raises.
changes.tan_xuan: Wider opening/isolation, differentiated multiway c-bets, stronger semi-bluffs and polarized late sizes.
changes.wesley: More opening/isolation/3-bets, late-street pressure and polarized sizes.
changes.st_wang: Wider but selective opening, more isolation/3-bets and restrained late polarization.
changes.keating: Wider opening/defense, sticky calls retained; less automatic value raising and smaller bluff pressure.
changes.shared: Prevent splitting a meaningful action across sizes from causing every size to be filtered out; ordinary table defaults remain unchanged.
